Electoral roll revision process begins amid voter list concerns

A Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls has commenced across several Indian states, including Karnataka and Delhi, involving door-to-door verification of voters. While the process aims to update voter lists, political parties, particularly the Congress, have raised objections and sought clarification from the Election Commission regarding its methodology and potential impact on voter inclusion. The Election Commission has not yet publicly responded to these specific objections.
